meta_policy_notes: The meta-policy will select a skill based on the current state, prioritizing recovery skills when the pole is significantly off-balance, and then switching between centering the cart and fine-tuning pole balance. It should learn to smoothly transition between these sub-goals, potentially combining skills or using a hierarchical approach where one skill is active while another is being prepared.

skills.name: balance_pole_upright
skills.description: Focuses on keeping the pole perfectly upright and minimizing its angular velocity, serving as the primary balancing skill.

reward_terms.description: Penalize deviation from the upright pole position (0 radians).
Penalize pole angular velocity to stop oscillation.

skills.name: return_cart_to_center
skills.description: Moves the cart back towards the track center when it's significantly off-center, prioritizing repositioning over fine-tuning.

reward_terms.description: Penalize cart distance from the center (0 meters).
Penalize cart velocity to encourage slowing down as it approaches the center.

skills.name: stabilize_cart_at_center
skills.description: Keeps the cart stationary and precisely at the center of the track once it's within an acceptable range, focusing on minimal movement.

reward_terms.description: Strongly penalize cart distance from center for precise positioning.
Strongly penalize cart velocity to keep it stationary.

skills.name: recover_from_large_pole_angle
skills.description: Prioritizes quickly bringing the pole back towards upright when it's at a large, potentially critical angle, to prevent it from falling.

reward_terms.description: Heavily penalize large pole angle to force rapid correction towards upright.
Penalize pole angular velocity to stop the fall and reverse its direction.
